gloss_en: Scent, fragrance (רֵיחַ) — an odor perceived through the nose/nostrils, the spiritual sense of smell linked to purity and awe of Heaven (as in 'תְּהִלָּתִי אֶחֱטָם לָךְ' and 'וַהֲרִיחוֹ בְּיִרְאַת ה''); distinct from the homographs/near-forms רֵאָה 'lung' and רוּחַ 'wind, spirit'

outliers.actual_gloss_en: lung (the bodily organ, whose wings fan the heart; 'named re'ah because it illuminates the eyes')
outliers.reason: The proof and paragraph speak exclusively of הָרֵאָה (the lung), its wings and wind, and the Chullin 49a derasha on the lung illuminating the eyes; no form of רֵיחַ 'scent' appears. This is a different word sharing similar letters, not the scent sense.
